text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, music) ::: x likes music.
WantsToCompose(x) ::: x wants to compose.
HasAccess(x, p) ::: x has access to program p.
CanCompose(x) ::: x can compose.
WillCompose(x) ::: x will compose.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → WantsToCompose(george) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
HasAccess(george, program) → CanCompose(george) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
CanCompose(george) ∧ WantsToCompose(george) → WillCompose(george) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, then he will compose.
Conclusion:
¬WillCompose(george) → ¬CanCompose(george) ::: If George will not compose, then George cannot compose.
